rows.details: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry
An implementation research study on developing a high-quality patient-centric integrated model for emergency care systems in selected districts of India
6 months (extended up to one year based on satisfactory performance of the candidate)
Up to 35 years (as on last date of receipt of applications)
JIPMER, Puducherry; travel to urban and rural health facilities in district of Pondicherry

content_sections.heading: About JIPMER Project Research Scientist – I (Medical)
content_sections.text: JIPMER is a medical education and research institute located at Dhanvantri Nagar, Puducherry. This post is part of an ICMR-funded implementation research study on developing a high-quality patient-centric integrated model for emergency care systems in selected districts of India. The Project Investigator (PI) is Dr. Manu Ayyan of the Department of Emergency Medicine & Trauma.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: MBBS Good communication skills in Tamil & English Research experience (one year) in field of emergency care or Qualitative research; experience in relevant field will be given priority Experience in working in projects/programs at State level Skills in planning and conducting research/survey related training programme Undertaken Health related field-based data collection Ability to plan, coordinate field-based survey The candidate must be willing to travel to urban and rural health facilities in district of Pondicherry for data collection. Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline/field and in a reputable institution/organization, and the experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. The maximum age limit is up to 35 years as on the last date of receipt of applications. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 80,400/- per month, made up of Rs. 67,000/- and Rs. 13,400 as 20% HRA. The likely duration of the engagement is 6 months, extended up to one year based on satisfactory performance of the candidate. The engagement may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the Project Investigator.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Research Scientist – I (Medical) Job Description
content_sections.text: Oversees the research and handles communications with State and District officials, ICMR on a regular basis Coordinates the formative research, outcome assessment, and implementation of the project Training, guiding and supervising Project Staff in their day-to-day work Conduct good literature search and synthesis, data management, data analysis, report writing Any other related work assigned Ability to work in a team

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Project Research Scientist – I (Medical)
content_sections.text: Filled application form (in the prescribed format) CV Supporting documents (scanned in one PDF)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted based on the details furnished in the application, CV and the documentary proof provided. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. The final selection will be based on CV, application, and written test/interview. After evaluation of the application form, the recruitment process will be as follows: Written test: Knowledge on Public Health, Emergency Care and Implementation Research. Interview: Ability to liaison with different and multiple organizations at State/National Level. The dates of the written test and interview are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JIPMER Project Research Scientist – I (Medical) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Research Scientist – I (Medical) in the ICMR-funded project at JIPMER, Puducherry.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The complete application must be sent by email by 4:30 PM on 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is MBBS with good communication skills in Tamil and English. One year of research experience in emergency care or qualitative research and State-level project experience are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is up to 35 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the JIPMER Project Research Scientist – I (Medical) post?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 80,400/- per month (Rs. 67,000/- + Rs. 13,400 as 20% HRA).

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 80,400 remuneration?
faq.answer: No, the Rs. 80,400/- per month already includes Rs. 13,400 as 20% HRA on Rs. 67,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form, CV and supporting documents, scanned in one PDF, to [email protected], with the post name in the subject line and the PDF named "Candidate name_post-name_year_application".

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applicants are shortlisted on the basis of their application, CV and documentary proof, and the final selection is based on CV, application, and a written test/interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job at JIPMER?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely on contract for an externally sponsored project for a likely duration of 6 months, extendable up to one year, with no claim to any regular post in JIPMER.
